facts.text: Beth Medrash Govoha is a yeshiva with over 9,000 students enrolled in undergraduate and graduate programs following the tradition of Slabodka, Slutzk, and Kletzk.

sources.title: BMG - Beth Medrash Govoa - Lakewood Yeshiva
sources.quote: Beth Medrash Govoha, follows in the path of the great Yeshivos of Slabodka, Slutzk and Kletzk. Over 9,000 students are enrolled in its undergraduate and graduate programs.
